description: Header file defining the MockPersistentNelStore class, a mock implementation of NetworkErrorLoggingService::PersistentNelStore for testing purposes. It includes command handling, policy management, and verification methods.

classes.name: MockPersistentNelStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of PersistentNelStore for testing network error logging policies.

classes.name: MockPersistentNelStore::Command
classes.description: Represents a command issued to the mock store, such as load, add, update, delete, or flush.

methods.name: LoadNelPolicies
methods.description: Loads stored policies and executes the provided callback.

methods.name: AddNelPolicy
methods.description: Adds a new network error logging policy.

methods.name: UpdateNelPolicyAccessTime
methods.description: Updates the access time for a given policy.

methods.name: FinishLoading
methods.description: Simulates completion of loading policies, invoking callbacks.

methods.name: VerifyCommands
methods.description: Verifies that the command list matches expected commands.

methods.name: GetAllCommands
methods.description: Returns all commands issued to the store.

methods.name: StoredPoliciesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of policies that would be stored.
